mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.root_comment_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.reply_to_comment_id, c.depth, c.author_user_id, u.display_name AS author_name, c.content, c.status, c.like_count, c.created_at FROM comment c JOIN user_account u ON u.id = c.author_user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.root_comment_id ASC, c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC
